implemented_scope.original: f1(Gamount)=Rm/(1+exp(-Gamount/(Vg*C1)+a1)) in mU/min; Gamount in mg, Vg in L, C1 in mg/L
implemented_scope.amplitude: Host-declared synthetic Sb fixes effective Rm in pmol/(kg min); published 209 mU/min is not converted or reused as a person-specific pancreatic molar rate
implemented_scope.route: Original f1 enters the plasma-insulin equation. Assigning its normalized shape to the host pancreatic/portal inlet is an explicit hybrid coupling hypothesis, not a verified prehepatic human rate.
implemented_scope.state: No source-owned physiological state in f1; required Z remains the unused host basal bookkeeping rate
